###### Made with Care in the Heart of Vermont!

Our innovative product line is manufactured right here in the USA, at our facility in Randolph
Vermont.

It includes the highly esteemed ErgoLite® radiation protection apron, proven to reduce
career-shortening stress injuries and our proprietary MRI-Safe™ Overhead Suspension Systems. 
* #### ErgoLite® X-Ray Aprons
* #### RayShield® Radiology Aprons
* #### Comfortlight® Aprons

* #### Radiology Barriers & Shields
* #### Medical Lighting Systems
* #### Surgical Radiology Protection
* #### Much More!

“ErgoLite® gives me good radiation protection. It helps my back and shoulders by redistributing the
weight onto my hips. It’s a great piece of equipment and I swear by it… It gives me safety, 360
degrees, it’s comfortable, and I don’t have to be concerned about my back during long cases. It’s a
winner on 3 counts.

## Radiation Protection Products

Barrier Technologies® is America’s leading manufacturer of **radiation protection products**. We are
committed to continual innovation and serving the medical industry by producing superior **radiation
shielding products** using high quality of **radiation shielding **materials.

## Our Radiation Protection Products

We control the quality of our products by manufacturing everything in-house. From metal fabrication
to fabric manufacturing and product assembly, all our **x ray** radiation products are created
within our facilities.

Our industry-leading products include lightweight lead-free aprons, [velcro-free thyroid
collars][29], protective gloves, leaded eye protection, [mobile lead shields][30], and many more
radiation safety products.

## Innovation in Radiation Protection Technology

Barrier Technologies’ tenacious drive to innovate is one of the qualities that sets us apart from
other radiation shield manufacturers. From leadership to engineering, every tier of our company is
motivated to develop new solutions to problems within our sphere of the medical industry.

### Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ Technology Products

Two powerful examples of our commitment to innovation are our Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ proprietary
products:
* **Ultraflex™** is an outer material for our aprons, vests, and mobile shields. Unlike traditional
  nylon, which is porous and can’t be washed, we engineered Ultraflex™ to be an antibacterial and
  stain-free fabric — helping medical personnel maintain a sterile environment.
* **MagnaGuard™** is a patented magnetic closure we developed to eliminate the use of velcro on
  aprons and thyroid guards. Studies have shown velcro to be a transmitter of dangerous bacteria and
  disease. MagnaGuard™ mitigates these risks.

Our innovative products are also inspired by our customers. For example, our breakthrough Terminator
XR™ mobile lead shields were developed after a local doctor asked us to create an alternative to
cumbersome hanging lead shields.

If you are dissatisfied with your current **radiation protection products**, contact our team and
inquire about our customization services.

## Radiation Protection Products Made in USA

From lead shields to protective eyewear, Barrier Technologies is your one-stop-shop for all things
**radiation shielding**. Our catalog includes everything necessary to build a robust, easy-to-clean
radiation protection suit:

### [Protective Aprons][31]

We offer an expansive variety of lead and lead-free aprons that can be customized to meet the unique
needs of your medical organization. Don’t have time to wait for a custom order? Then order from our
Ready To Go line of aprons — a selection of Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ equipped aprons that ship
within 24 hours of your order.

### [Radiation Protection Gloves][32]

Our lead-free and powder-free Secure Touch® gloves empower your physicians with the highest level of
**radiation shielding** in the industry. Textured fingers and palms improve grip and we’ve designed
the gloves with curved fingers and a hypoallergenic internal coating to maximize comfort.

### [Radiation Protective Eyewear][33]

Our vast catalog of leaded glasses provide the highest lead content in the industry and can be
delivered in your exact prescription. In contrast to foreign-made eyewear, our lenses don’t yellow
over time and can be coated with an anti-reflective and anti-fog coating for maximum clarity.

## protection shields.

Welcome! BLOXR Solutions is a USA manufacturer of proprietary scatter radiation protection products
(“lead” aprons and attenuating hand cream). BLOXR® products are designed to reduce exposure for
clinicians and patients through innovative applications of its patented technologies. Applicable to
users in hospitals, surgical centers, cardiac cath labs, interventional radiology, orthopedics,
radiology departments, imaging facilities, veterinary practices, dental offices or anywhere
protection is needed. [Find out more][27] about our lead-free x-ray aprons and products.

### Personalize your garments

At BLOXR Solutions, we offer a variety of ways to create a unique look or to outfit a team in a
coordinating color scheme. Options include monogramming, logo embroidery, pockets for dosimeters,
and more.

### 
### Lead equivalent protection

BLOXR® XPF® garments are independently validated 0.5 mm Pb equivalent. All BLOXR aprons, vests,
skirts, thyroid collars, and garments for scatter radiation protection feature a patented,
lightweight XPF bi-layer constructed of barium sulfate and bismuth oxide. XPF does not contain lead
or toxic heavy metals, making BLOXR protection “greener” than x-ray aprons containing lead, tungsten
and antimony.

### 
### Other protective options

In addition to traditional x-ray aprons, vests, skirts, and thyroid collars, BLOXR offers other ways
to protect against scatter radiation. Caps for brain protection, bra inserts for those concerned
about the breast area, shin guards, and arm sleeves provide additional protection for surgeons,
techs, and clinical staff. Protective [eyeglasses ][28]are also available.

# Diagnostic Imaging Physics Consulting & Radiation Safety Services

Board-certified, state-licensed medical physicists providing diagnostic imaging physics, radiation
safety, and accreditation support across Florida, Maryland, Virginia, Washington DC, California, and
Nevada.

Diagnostic Radiological Physics Services (DRPS) provides medical physics consulting and radiation
safety services for radiation-using facilities—including equipment performance evaluations,
shielding design, and accreditation support—to help you maintain safe, compliant imaging operations.

Our qualified medical physicists support ACR, IAC, RadSite, MQSA, and Joint Commission accreditation
programs, plus regulatory compliance, shielding design, and equipment performance evaluations.

We help your team stay **inspection-ready, accreditation-ready, and audit-ready**—with practical
solutions and responsive service.

[Request Services][34] [Explore Our Services][35]

## Diagnostic Medical Physics Consulting

Our board-certified diagnostic medical physicists provide CT physics testing, MRI physics testing,
nuclear medicine and PET physics, mammography MQSA support, and radiography and fluoroscopy surveys.

We deliver equipment performance evaluations and protocol optimization so your imaging systems
maintain image quality, manage dose, and meet regulatory and accreditation expectations.

### Equipment Performance Evaluations (EPEs)

Acceptance testing and periodic performance evaluations meeting ACR, MQSA, and state requirements,
with clear documentation for your records and inspectors.

### X-ray & Fluoroscopy Physics Services

Surveys and performance evaluations for general radiography and fluoroscopy systems, including
C-arms and R/F rooms, with attention to image quality, dose, and regulatory compliance.

### CT Physics Services

CT phantom testing, dose index evaluation, and performance checks to support safe operation,
protocol optimization, and CT accreditation requirements.

### MRI Physics Services

MRI system performance evaluations, phantom testing, and support for MRI safety programs, including
image quality evaluations and safety-related checks, coil performance, and consistency over time.

### Mammography Physics (MQSA) Services

Mammography physics support and performance evaluations that align with MQSA and accreditation
expectations for image quality and dose.

### Nuclear Medicine & PET Physics Services

Performance evaluations for nuclear medicine and PET systems, including camera and dose calibrator
checks, with documentation suited for accreditation and regulatory review.

[Medical physics consulting services →][36]

## Radiation Safety & Shielding

Named RSO services and radiation safety consulting for facilities with radioactive materials,
designed to support a robust, defensible radiation safety program.

We support radiation safety programs from fundamentals to advanced needs, helping facilities
maintain regulatory defensibility and consistent practices.

### Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) Services

RSO support tailored to your program, including policy and procedure development, audits, incident
review, ongoing compliance monitoring, and preparation for regulatory inspections.

[Learn more about RSO services →][37]

### Radiation Safety Consulting

Practical guidance on regulatory requirements, radiation protection practices, and program
improvements that reduce risk and support safe operations.

### Shielding Design & Radiation Protection Consulting

Expert radiation shielding design and calculations for new construction and renovations, including
documentation suitable for architectural review, regulatory approval, and post-construction
verification.

[Learn more →][38]

## Accreditation & Inspection Support

We support accreditation and readiness programs required by imaging programs and healthcare quality
organizations. [Learn more about our accreditation support services][39].
* **ACR Accreditation Support** (CT, MRI, NM, PET, Mammography)
* **IAC Support** (as applicable by modality)
* **MQSA Support**
* **Joint Commission readiness** (physics documentation and compliance support)
* Survey-ready documentation: physics reports, performance data, and QA records organized for easy

From freshwater rivers, lakes and lagoons to coastal marine cages, trout farming is a dynamic sub
sector of aquaculture in Latin America, which supports thousands of livelihoods across the region.
But trout raised in open water farms are vulnerable to diseases that spread easily in water.

## What you can do with Mergr


### Build targeted lists of private equity firms

Create custom lists based on firm criteria, stated investment focus, or actual acquisition activity.

### Search companies by ownership and acquisition history

Find companies based on current ownership, past acquisitions, or divestitures.

### Filter M&A transactions by key deal attributes

Search transactions by target, industry, deal size, acquirer type, or seller type.

### Identify the most active buyers and sellers

Find private equity firms and corporate acquirers based on transaction activity by industry,
geography, or time period.

### Explore relationships between firms, deals, and advisors

Understand how private equity firms, corporate acquirers, and advisors connect across transactions.

### Search M&A press releases by keyword

Discover past and recent transactions by searching the full text of 100,000+ M&A press releases.

## Who uses Mergr

Investment Bankers - Business Brokers - Accountants - Lawyers
Executive Recruiters - Corporate Development Groups
Wealth Advisors - Business Owners - Investors
Consultants - Sales Professionals
Research Professionals


* Which public companies have been the most active aquirers in the chemicals sector the last four

* What advisors have worked with companies based in Minnesota?
* Who are the professionals that work for New York City-based private equity firms?
* What companies have been the most active sellers in the last year?

Protect Physicians and Healthcare Staff from C-arm Scatter Radiation at the Source.

[Row midpoint Shape]

### Scatter Radiation Protection at the Touch of a Button

The Radiaction Smart Shield offers a dynamic barrier of protection for the medical team. This
innovative technology transfers the shielding from the personnel to the fluoroscopy system. With
rapid 2-3 second deployment and retraction, Radiaction maintains workflow efficiency while enabling
immediate patient access.

###### [Validated by clinical experts ][59]

[Row midpoint Shape]
[Value to Hospital Staff with Radiaction Medical Devices]

### Your Medical Teams Deserve the Best Protection Possible

Radiaction Medical has developed the first system to proactively block radiation at the source,
providing the interventional team with comprehensive scatter radiation protection.

###### [Learn more about Radiaction Smart Shield ][60]

### Maintain Full-Service Capacity and Procedural Volume

Reduce opportunity loss by adopting the most advanced radiation protection available. Radiaction
Smart Shield assists hospitals in meeting occupational safety standards for radiation exposure.

###### [Increase facility capacity and productivity ][61]

[Portrait of a happy female surgeon smiling in an operating theatre - Copyspce]

### Trusted in Clinical Settings

Dr. Ashish Bhatia | Electrophysiologist

"Prior to Radiaction, I was speaking to my facility about decreasing my procedure hours due to my
concerns with radiation exposure, now I feel great comfort having the system in my EP lab, and I
never want to perform procedures without it…the blue light indicating the system is deployed gives
me great comfort."

#### Assuta Ashdod University MC

Prof. Avishag Laish-Farkash | Head of Electrophysiology

“Protecting myself and my team from scatter radiation is a top priority. Performing long ablation
procedures and increased procedure volume exposes electrophysiologists to a high level of
accumulated radiation, which becomes a real concern.”

#### Assuta Ashdod University Medical Center

Prof. Eli Lev | Director Cardiology Department

“Our staff is exposed to a significant amount of scatter radiation, and our aim is to try and
decrease and reduce radiation as much as we can….I have to say the system is very easy to deploy and
operate. It incorporates very well with the flow of the coronary cath and EP arena. We have seen
with our experience that it reduces radiation by over 90 percent, a very significant amount of
radiation reduction.”

# Advanced Radiation Detection Solutions

in Australia & New Zealand

Radtronics helps you detect, monitor and identify radiation using the most advanced instruments
available on the market. As the exclusive Australian agent for Rotem Industries, Mirion
Technologies, and RADeCO Inc, we provide top-tier radiation detection and monitoring equipment. Our
solutions are designed to meet the highest standards, ensuring accurate and reliable results.

[ Contact Us ][44]

## Professional Equipment and Services

We offer a quality range of equipment and systems, along with extensive application support,
maintenance, repairs and calibration services. Our experienced team is dedicated to providing
exceptional service, ensuring that all equipment is maintained to the highest standards. We can keep
a check on your instruments and ensure that they keep performing optimally and also help you if you
need routine maintenance, urgent repairs or precise calibration. With Radtronics, you can trust that
your radiation detection needs are in capable hands.

Radiation
detection

Our advanced instruments quickly and accurately detect the presence of radiation, ensuring safety
and compliance in various environments.

measurement

We offer precise measurement tools that quantify radiation levels, providing critical data for
monitoring and analysis.

identification

Our cutting-edge technology identifies specific types of radiation, enabling targeted responses and

About Us

**Radiation Protection Services, Ltd.** is now part of **West Physics**, a national company that
provides radiation physics consulting services for medical facilities and industries that utilize
x-ray producing equipment or radioactive materials.

Our Springfield field office provides services in the entire Illinois region, extending to eastern
Missouri, southeast Iowa, and western Indiana. With our central location, we provide flexible and
quick response times with personal service. Our staff are cognizant of the regulations for
compliance as required by the Illinois Emergency Management Agency, Missouri Radiation Control
Program, Iowa Department of Public Health, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission and accreditation
agencies (ACR, Joint Commission, IAC) associated with medical imaging facilities. We maintain a
client database to assure timely evaluations of imaging equipment and use of radioactive materials.


From radiographic rooms to cardiac catheterization suites, we will assist with keeping your imaging
equipment compliant with current standards.  [More…][13]


CT support includes instructions for clients on data collection prior to the initial visit.
 [More…][14]


We have consultants to assist with your nuclear medicine needs, whether it is hot lab equipment,
SPECT/CT or PET/CT.  [More…][15]


Our Consultant provides services to maintain compliance with MQSA and ACR standards. We have
experience supporting mammography departments for over 20 years.  [More…][16]


An MRI safety audit is performed upon initial consultation to establish program requirements.
 [More…][17]


Licensed to utilize radioactive materials by the Illinois Emergency Management Agency. State
licensed to calibrate radiation survey instruments & perform leakage and/or contamination tests on
sealed radioactive sources.  [More…][18]

2018 amendments) state that any company working with sources of ionising radiation (x-rays and
radioactive isotopes) have a legal responsibility to appoint a suitable RPA, RWA, MPE or a
combination of these.

## About Stalcraft Meta

I built Stalcraft Meta to give players a set of tools for analyzing the mechanics of the Zone. These
tools use game data and simulation models to help you understand how different equipment choices
affect your performance.

You can use the platform to compare **artifact combinations** or run **ballistics simulations**. The
goal is to provide specific numbers so you can decide which loadout works best for your current
situation.

Whether you are looking for a balance between Effective HP and healing, or want to know the exact
time-to-kill for a weapon at 50 meters, these tools provide the calculations you need.

## Why Use Stalcraft Meta?

The game changes frequently with balance patches and new items. This platform stays current by
syncing with game data, providing models that account for the specific ways items interact in-game.
* **Precision Simulations:** Our Monte Carlo TTK simulations account for real-world variables like
  hit distribution and plate absorption.
* **Advanced Optimization:** The artifact optimizer uses memetic algorithms to explore millions of
  combinations in seconds.
* **Complete Item Wiki:** Access detailed stats, barter recipes, and upgrade paths for every item in
  the game.

Survival Focus

Calculate EHP and healing to ensure you can withstand the Zone's deadliest threats.

Mobility Meta

Maximize your speed and stamina to outrun anomalies and rival factions alike.

Fast Optimization

Our engine uses smart search to check thousands of combinations in seconds.

## About Stalcraft Meta

I built Stalcraft Meta to give players a set of tools for analyzing the mechanics of the Zone. These
tools use game data and simulation models to help you understand how different equipment choices
affect your performance.

You can use the platform to compare **artifact combinations** or run **ballistics simulations**. The
goal is to provide specific numbers so you can decide which loadout works best for your current
situation.

Whether you are looking for a balance between Effective HP and healing, or want to know the exact
time-to-kill for a weapon at 50 meters, these tools provide the calculations you need.

## Why Use Stalcraft Meta?

The game changes frequently with balance patches and new items. This platform stays current by
syncing with game data, providing models that account for the specific ways items interact in-game.
* **Precision Simulations:** Our Monte Carlo TTK simulations account for real-world variables like
  hit distribution and plate absorption.
* **Advanced Optimization:** The artifact optimizer uses memetic algorithms to explore millions of
  combinations in seconds.
* **Complete Item Wiki:** Access detailed stats, barter recipes, and upgrade paths for every item in
  the game.

Survival Focus

Calculate EHP and healing to ensure you can withstand the Zone's deadliest threats.

Mobility Meta

Maximize your speed and stamina to outrun anomalies and rival factions alike.

Fast Optimization

Our engine uses smart search to check thousands of combinations in seconds.

Trivitron delivers integrated, adaptable technology that strengthens healthcare from remote

communities. From newborn screening to outbreak diagnostics, we empower national programs with
portable, cost-effective systems saving lives in resource-limited settings.

speed, and seamless automation. From routine to specialized tests, our advanced IVD platforms and
complete range of healthcare solutions deliver fast, reliable results that drive better clinical
decisions - globally.

### Hospitals and Clinics

Seamless technology for frontline care. Integrated medical technology solutions for confident,
real-time care. From patient monitors and ventilators to point-of-care devices, our modular systems
integrate effortlessly across rural clinics and tertiary hospitals.

### AI Solutions

AI That Works in the Real World. Practical AI for faster, more accurate diagnostics and smarter
workflows. From radiology image enhancement to predictive lab analytics, our clinically validated
tools integrate seamlessly into daily practice.

###### Radiation Shielding products & expertise comes standard.

Ultraray Radiation Protection offers radiation protection & lead shielding materials for a variety
of industries & facilities including hospitals, clinics, construction, industrial non-destructive
testing, power generation, security & defence, aerospace, and nuclear.

In addition to simply supplying radiation protection materials such as [sheet lead][55], [lead-lined
drywall][56], [lead-lined doors][57] or [lead bricks][58], we also offer
[radiopharmacy equipment][59], fixtures and complete turnkey solutions

Visit [Ultraray Medical][60] if you’re looking for personal radiation protection products such as
[lead aprons][61], lead vests & leaded eyewear.

**Precision Vision Care, Engineered for Professional and Everyday Use**

**VeritasTeq** is a specialty **Vision Care Company** focused on precision-engineered eyewear across
two business verticals: **Radiation Protection Eyewear Components** supply to OEM partners and
**Luxury Consumer Eyewear** under the **Mozzati** brand. Built on medical-device design discipline,
regulatory alignment and advanced material science, the company develops application-specific
eyewear frames alongside engineered lens solutions, working closely with global lens manufacturing
partners for execution. Its approach emphasizes performance, durability and consistency—combining
engineering rigor with refined design to deliver eyewear defined by performance, durability and a
level of finish associated with luxury craftsmanship.

**Radiation Protection — Engineering-Led OEM Solutions**

VeritasTeq’s core business is the design and development of radiation protection eyewear components
for medical applications. Operating as an OEM partner, the company engineers application-specific
frame systems and lens configurations tailored to clinical environments, rather than adapting
conventional eyewear formats. Built on medical-device design discipline, material integrity, and
compliance-driven processes, this vertical prioritizes safety, performance, and long-term
reliability in demanding use conditions.

**Mozzati — Precision-Crafted Consumer Eyewear**

Through its brand Mozzati, VeritasTeq extends this foundation into the consumer segment—offering
eyewear frames and sunglasses that combine refined design with precision components. Drawing on the
same engineering discipline used in its professional vertical, Mozzati delivers the look, feel, and
build quality associated with luxury eyewear, while remaining accessible to a broader audience.

A measured expression of luxury, precision, and enduring design. Explore the entire collection at
the [Mozzati Brand Website][15]
